title: unified-rollouts-integrated-canary-shadow-autorollback-workflow
author: Maya Patel
release_notes: Add integrated canary + shadow rollout workflow with automated metric-driven rollback; improvements to observability and e2e coverage for safety guards; no API surface breaking changes.
description:
Motivation: we need a single, auditable rollout workflow that supports canary, A/B and shadow traffic modes and ties automated rollback decisions to composite health metrics. This PR implements an integrated controller and runtime primitives so model lifecycle changes (model version pinning, canary weighting, shadow probing) can be expressed declaratively and executed with safety guards.

What changed (high level): consolidated the rollout engine, added a metric-driven autorollback engine, added shadow probing hooks for non-invasive telemetry, extended tracing and metrics for per-model and per-route observability, and added e2e tests and a migration for existing rollout configs.

Design summary: the rollout controller now exposes a unified Rollout CRD (mutable via API) which supports staged canaries, weighted A/B, and shadow probing stages. The autorollback engine evaluates a composite SLO (latency P95, error rate, quality regressions from eval hooks) using a sliding window and quorum logic before triggering rollback. Shadow traffic is executed in a probing mode that runs the candidate model in parallel but does not affect user traffic; probe results are aggregated and compared via the same composite metric pipeline. We added explicit quarantine and preflight stages to reduce noisy rollbacks.

Implementation details: controller refactor (Go), autorollback engine (Go), probe runner shim (Python) to reuse existing model sandbox harness, observability additions (metrics/traces in runtime and controller), and 12 new e2e/ integration tests in the harness. Configs: rollout schema version bumped to v2 with backwards-compatible migration logic to upgrade existing v1 rollouts.

Testing and CI: unit tests + integration tests added for rollback logic and metric quorum. e2e tests run in the perf-canary lab and pass under the new safety guards; we added flakiness guards to reduce false positives.

Rollout plan: staged rollout to production: enable controller on staging, run shadow probing for 48 hours, run 5% canary for 30 minutes, evaluate composite metrics, increase to 20% for 2 hours, then full rollout. If composite metric quorum fails at any stage, autorollback triggers an immediate rollback and opens a quarantine window for investigation.

Migration notes: existing Rollout v1 objects are migrated automatically on controller startup; customers who have custom webhook integrations should validate payload compatibility.

Why this is safe: multiple safety layers (preflight, quarantine, metric quorum, manual aborts) and strong observability reduce the chance of noisy rollbacks and allow fast remediation.

Follow-ups: add UI controls for staged promotion and a rollout timeline in Redwood Console (ENG-4894), tighten default metric thresholds based on production telemetry (ENG-4923).

impact_summary: Enables integrated canary + shadow workflow with automated rollback using composite metrics; improves safety and observability for model lifecycle operations. Expected to reduce manual rollback incidents and speed safe promotions.
notes: This PR intentionally keeps migration logic non-destructive; operators can opt-out of automatic migration by setting ROLLOUT_MIGRATE=false.
